prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a small old hill village of farmers and storytellers. dark brown wooden shingle roof walls of stacked round logs with notched corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 176 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the user-provided layout-guide image into ONE isolated JRPG town-map house sprite. Treat the attached image as a strict pixel-coordinate layout mask, NOT merely inspiration. Preserve its canvas, building outer silhouette and its roof/front-wall horizontal split precisely. Keep BOTH yellow window rectangles exactly where and the same size as in the full original image, and preserve the dark-brown ground-level door rectangle in its exact original position and dimensions (it must remain a usable, obvious door, not a window). Roof viewed from above occupies the upper building block; vertical front wall viewed straight-on occupies lower block. One-storey old hill-village farmers' and storytellers' log cottage. Roof: dark brown wooden shingles, rectangular rows of chunky individual shingle clusters, slightly uneven and weathered; walls: horizontally stacked ROUND timber logs with notched interlocking corners. Warm amber-lit small-paned windows (ONLY luminous elements), dark wood frames, occasional compact flower box beneath a window. Door dark brown wooden boards within its exact original rectangle. Optional subtle eave and trim, chimney above the roof within empty top margin. Transparent alpha background replacing ONLY original magenta; absolutely no magenta visible in finished sprite. No ground, no shadows, no human figures, no letters or text. Keep roof and wall within the guide's bounds; preserve the specified small setback of wall under roof. Premium hand-placed modern HD JRPG pixel art; uniformly sized crisp square art pixels on an exact 176 by 224 art-pixel grid (original guide is 7x nearest-neighbor enlarged), pixel-edge alignment, absolutely no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur, brushes, photo texture, noise or checkerboard dithering. Solid clusters of 3–10 art pixels with clean silhouettes. Earthy hues with 4–6 discrete shades per material, warm yellow highlights and saturated purple-red shadows. Neutral soft even overcast upper-left ambient illumination, clean base daytime/evening colors: no night darkening, cast shadows, glowing light pools, vignette.
